points.quote: Only basic JavaScript and ECMAScript APIs. It has no DOM and no Node. It can import only other `common` code.
DOM and Web APIs. It can import `common` and other `browser` code.
Node.js APIs. It can import `common` and other `node` code.
Electron renderer APIs, such as the `ipcRenderer` exposed through the preload. It can import `common`, `browser` and other `electron-browser` code.
Electron main-process APIs. It can import `common`, `node` and other `electron-main` code.
